purpose: source-first real distill curation; labels before clustering; no models/tokenizers/servers/questions/folds/results read

topic_definitions.reactive-ui-state: Reactive frontend state, component bindings, events and conditional/list/form rendering.
topic_definitions.cli-interfaces: Command-line interfaces: argument/option declarations, command context, help and terminal presentation.
topic_definitions.http-requests: HTTP request/response lifecycle, client sessions/authentication, timeouts, server middleware and error handling.
topic_definitions.python-environments: Python package installation, dependency resolution, reproducible project/tool environments.
topic_definitions.python-testing: Automated Python tests: fixtures/assertions, mocking/property/async testing, coverage and test orchestration.
topic_definitions.typed-data: Typed data validation, schema checking, coercion and structured serialization.
topic_definitions.code-quality: Python source formatting, linting, style checking and static analysis.
topic_definitions.cryptographic-security: Cryptographic primitives, secure transport, and cryptographic random-generator statistical tests.

membership_policy: Assign a primary topic from the dominant actual document purpose; cross-topic requires substantive material in at least two definitions; noise means no dominant membership, not keyword absence. All decisions require original-source evidence and independent review before freezing.
grouping_policy: Preserve each existing frozen source_group exactly. New supplemental groups are one per official upstream repository. Derivative, translated or duplicate content must never increase independent-group counts. These groups are predeclared provenance units, not a statistical independence guarantee.
base_rule: >=100 documents and >=8 distinct existing/new source groups per primary topic; cross-topic/noise do not satisfy topic group minima
freeze_requires: source manifest and labels materialization integrity check
explicit approval to freeze data; no quality claim
